name: Facebook
tagline: The world's largest social network: friends, groups, video, Marketplace
facts: Zuckerberg (Meta CEO); Tom Alison, Head of Facebook

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Stay the everyday app for friends, communities and local life, while winning back young adults.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Shift from friend feed to AI-recommended video and discovery engine; recommendations lift time spent.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: 3B-user graph, Groups and Marketplace network effects, and the deepest ad-targeting data in the world.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Young adults: Local tab, Marketplace in nav bar, Dating Matchmaker, Messenger Communities, full-screen video.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Can Facebook be cool again for 18-29s, or should it optimise for its 35+ core?

customers.who: 25+ adults keeping up with friends, family
customers.pain: Want updates, events, birthdays in one place
customers.why: Everyone they know is there; Groups, Events, Memories

customers.pain: Find local things, buy and sell cheaply, meet people
customers.why: Marketplace, Local tab, Dating, full-screen video

customers.who: Group owners, local organisers, fan groups
customers.pain: Need tools to run large communities
customers.why: Groups with moderation tools, admin assist, Messenger Communities

customers.pain: Need customers at low CAC with measurement
customers.why: Advantage+ AI campaigns, Pages, click-to-message, Marketplace listings

customers.pain: Need reach and payouts beyond YouTube
customers.why: Facebook content monetisation program, Reels reach, cross-post from Instagram

products.name: Groups
products.desc: Interest and local communities, public or private

products.name: Messenger
products.desc: Chat app, Communities for topic-based group chats

portfolio.north_star: Daily users having meaningful interactions with friends or groups
portfolio.key_metrics: DAU, comments and shares, Group participation, Messenger threads
portfolio.guardrails: Misinformation prevalence, integrity reports, notification fatigue

products.name: Video tab / Reels
products.desc: Full-screen player for short, long and live

products.name: Local tab
products.desc: Nearby Reels, Marketplace, Groups and Events in one place

products.name: Meta AI
products.desc: Assistant integrated into feed, search and chat

portfolio.north_star: Time spent on satisfying recommended video per DAU
portfolio.key_metrics: Video watch time, recommended content share, young-adult DAU
portfolio.guardrails: Clickbait and unoriginal content share, user satisfaction surveys

products.name: Marketplace
products.desc: Local and shipped buy-sell listings; used by 1 in 4 young-adult DAUs

portfolio.north_star: Successful transactions or matches per weekly user
portfolio.key_metrics: Listings, buyer messages, sell-through, ad ROAS
portfolio.guardrails: Scam and fraud rate, counterfeit listings, user safety reports

rows.who_pays: SMBs, especially in India, Brazil, SE Asia
rows.how: Ads open Messenger or WhatsApp threads
Sponsored listings in Marketplace; partner catalog integrations

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: FoA Q2'26 $60.4B, of which $59.4B ads (+27%); Facebook app is a large share, not broken out.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Billions of free users; millions of advertisers pay; US/Canada ARPU far above Asia-Pacific.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Q2'26 impressions +14%, price per ad +12%; FoA margins fund Reality Labs and AI capex.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: AI ranking and ad models, video ad load, business messaging, Marketplace and Meta AI ads.

bullets.label: Cost side
bullets.text: 2026 capex guided $115-135B for superintelligence labs and AI infrastructure.

friction: Feed feels cluttered with recommendations, not friends
Seen as an 'older people' app by Gen Z
Scams, fake accounts and spam in Marketplace and Groups
Privacy distrust lingering since Cambridge Analytica
Too many tabs and features; hard to navigate

competitors.label: Social / video
competitors.text: TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, X; Instagram internally

competitors.label: Commerce
competitors.text: Craigslist, OLX, eBay, Nextdoor, Quikr in India

competitors.label: Ads
competitors.text: Google, Amazon Ads, TikTok, retail media networks

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Scale plus targeting data plus AI ad tools no rival matches

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Ageing user base, regulation (EU DMA, privacy), AI capex eroding margins

news.text: Meta Q2: revenue $60.8B (+28%), DAP 3.6B, ad prices +12%

news.text: Young-adult DAU trend, Meta AI monetisation, EU less-personalised ads

sources: Meta 10-K FY25, Q2 2026 earnings release, Meta newsroom, SocialPilot/Buffer user estimates, press coverage. App-level figures are estimates. Prepared Oct 2026.
